metadata.description: Skills for the handoff → compact → resume workflow. Preserve key session context across compactions, with a confirmation gate on resume.

plugins.name: handoff-save
plugins.description: Save the current session state to a structured handoff document before running compact, so the next session can resume without losing key context.

plugins.name: handoff-resume
plugins.description: Load a saved handoff and run a one-time entry checkpoint (summarize → list options → wait for explicit user direction, or verify a durable on-disk authorization) before any state-changing action.
